question: A cell is placed in a solution and water moves out of the cell by osmosis. What can be concluded about the external solution?
options: It is hypotonic to the cell contents
It is hypertonic to the cell contents
It is isotonic to the cell contents
It has a higher water potential than the cell

question: Which of the following best describes the process of meiosis?
options: Cell division that produces two genetically identical diploid daughter cells
Cell division that produces four genetically unique haploid daughter cells
Cell division that produces two genetically unique haploid daughter cells
Cell division that produces four genetically identical diploid daughter cells

question: In a circuit, three resistors of 4Ω, 6Ω, and 12Ω are connected in parallel. What is the total resistance of the combination?
options: 2Ω
4Ω

question: Which type of bond is formed when electrons are transferred from one atom to another?
options: Covalent bond
Metallic bond
Ionic bond
Hydrogen bond

question: A plant is kept in the dark for 48 hours and then a leaf is tested for starch. What result would be expected and why?
options: Starch present, because the plant stored starch from previous photosynthesis in all leaves
No starch present, because without light the plant cannot perform photosynthesis to produce glucose for starch synthesis
Starch present, because respiration produces starch as a byproduct in the dark
No starch present, because the plant converts all starch to proteins in the dark

question: The half-life of a radioactive isotope is 20 years. If a sample initially contains 80g of the isotope, how much remains after 60 years?
options: 5g

question: Which of the following correctly describes the role of enzymes in biochemical reactions?
options: They are consumed in the reaction and increase the activation energy
They lower the activation energy and are not permanently altered by the reaction
They raise the activation energy and are regenerated at the end
They provide energy for the reaction and change their shape permanently

question: Which electromagnetic waves have the shortest wavelength?
options: Radio waves
Visible light
Ultraviolet rays
Gamma rays

question: In the Haber process, nitrogen and hydrogen react to form ammonia. Which conditions are used to achieve an economically viable yield?
options: High temperature (800°C), low pressure, and no catalyst
Low temperature (150°C), high pressure (200 atm), and iron catalyst
Moderate temperature (450°C), high pressure (200 atm), and iron catalyst
High temperature (450°C), low pressure (10 atm), and platinum catalyst

question: A food chain is: grass → grasshopper → frog → snake → hawk. If the grass contains 100,000 kJ of energy, assuming a 10% efficiency at each trophic level, how much energy is available to the hawk?
options: 10 kJ
1 kJ
100 kJ

question: Which statement correctly describes the difference between mitosis and meiosis?
options: Mitosis produces haploid cells; meiosis produces diploid cells
Mitosis results in genetic variation through crossing over; meiosis does not
Mitosis produces genetically identical cells for growth and repair; meiosis produces genetically diverse gametes
Mitosis involves two rounds of cell division; meiosis involves only one round

question: A negatively charged rod is brought near an uncharged metal sphere. Which phenomenon is responsible for the redistribution of charge in the sphere?
options: Electromagnetic induction
Electrostatic induction
Photoelectric effect
Thermionic emission

question: An object is placed 15 cm from a converging lens with a focal length of 10 cm. What is the nature and position of the image formed?
options: Virtual, upright image at 30 cm on the same side as the object
Real, inverted image at 30 cm on the opposite side of the lens
Real, upright image at 6 cm on the opposite side of the lens
Virtual, inverted image at 6 cm on the same side as the object

question: Which of the following is a correct statement about natural selection?
options: Organisms develop new traits by willing themselves to change in response to the environment
Individuals with favorable heritable traits are more likely to survive and reproduce, passing those traits to offspring
All members of a species evolve at the same rate in response to environmental changes
Mutations always benefit an organism and increase its chances of survival

question: When copper(II) sulfate solution undergoes electrolysis using copper electrodes, what happens at the anode?
options: Hydrogen gas is released as water is oxidized
Oxygen gas is produced as sulfate ions are discharged
Copper atoms are oxidized and the anode gradually dissolves into solution
Copper ions are reduced and deposited on the anode
